Job Description
Mandatory Skills
Strong hands-on experience in Python (production-grade development)
Experience in building and deploying Generative AI / LLM-based solutions
Strong knowledge of RAG architecture and LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain or similar)
Experience with vector databases and embeddings
Advanced SQL (complex queries, performance optimization)
Experience developing APIs (FastAPI/Flask)
Working knowledge of OpenShift (OCP) and containerization (Docker)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
Good to Have
Experience with model fine-tuning
Exposure to cloud AI services (Azure/AWS/GCP)
Understanding of MLOps practices
Experience in banking/insurance domain
We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer capable of independently designing and delivering end-to-end GenAI solutions. The role requires strong Python and SQL expertise, hands-on experience with LLMs and RAG architectures, and working knowledge of OpenShift-based deployments. The candidate should be able to: Design and build scalable GenAI solutions Develop and optimize RAG pipelines Build APIs and integrate structured/unstructured data sources Deploy solutions on OCP with minimal supervision Take ownership from design to production The expectation is that after
Mandatory Competencies
Data Science and Machine Learning - Gen AI
Data Science and Machine Learning - Python
Programming Language - Python - Flask
DevOps/Configuration Mgmt - Docker
Database - SQL
